meta.name: Ab Hoga Hisaab
meta.description:
Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

Returning Series · First aired 18 Jun 2026 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Arré Studio · Network: Prime Video, Amazon MX Player

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Ghar Wapasi
videos.overview: After being deported from Canada, Bobby Manocha hides the truth from his family and focuses on securing a better future for his younger brother Bunty. But when Bunty and his girlfriend Lovely stumble into a shocking discovery after a run-in with the police, they are pulled into the orbit of Lovely's influential father, Goldy Sekhon, a man whose world is far more dangerous than it appears.

videos.title: Karz Aur Farz
videos.overview: As Bobby hides the truth about his return, tensions erupt when an old family loan threatens the Manochas with losing their home. Determined to turn things around, Bobby and Bunty search for ways to secure their future. But while the brothers chase hope and opportunity, unseen forces are already shaping their fate, drawing them closer to a world far darker than they can imagine.

videos.title: Pyaar Aur Paise Ka Khel
videos.overview: A seemingly simple opportunity offers the Manocha family a chance to solve several of their problems at once. As Bobby begins to see hope for the future, Bunty finds himself dealing with unexpected complications of his own. With pressures mounting on both brothers, a series of events threatens to upend their plans and test their bond.

videos.title: Ek Jhooth Ki Museebat
videos.overview: Surjeet learns Bobby has been hiding the truth about his deportation, but the family's focus shifts to getting Bunty out of jail. Though released, Bunty becomes increasingly convinced that Shanno's disappearance is tied to a larger network.

videos.title: Sapno Ki Qeemat
videos.overview: Bunty's search for answers draws him closer to Goldy Sekhon's world, while Bobby finally comes clean about the lies that have been tearing their family apart. As tensions between the brothers reach a breaking point, events elsewhere take a dark and tragic turn. Faced with mounting pressures and fading dreams, Bunty makes a life-changing decision for the sake of his family.

videos.title: Bunty Ki Chaal
videos.overview: As wedding preparations gather pace, both Bobby and Bunty find themselves trapped by promises they may not be able to keep. Bunty's new job places him closer to the answers he seeks, while Bobby takes on lucrative work that feels increasingly suspicious. With questions mounting around Lakha's death and tensions rising on all fronts, the brothers edge closer to a dangerous truth.

videos.title: Mohre
videos.overview: Bunty's growing success earns him the attention of Goldy Sekhon, who entrusts him with an important assignment in Delhi just days before his wedding. While Bobby steps in to help with the preparations, Bunty returns at the last moment, visibly changed by something he refuses to discuss.

videos.title: Adhoori Baat
videos.overview: A week after the wedding, tensions begin to surface within the Manocha family. Bunty's strange behaviour leaves his loved ones concerned, while Bobby struggles to arrange money and paperwork for his brother's future. As family obligations, financial pressures and unanswered questions continue to pile up, the brothers find themselves drifting apart at the very moment they need each other most.

videos.title: Daag
videos.overview: Bunty's disappearance sends shockwaves through the Manocha family as rumours, accusations and unanswered questions begin to pile up. While investigators develop their own theories about what may have happened, Bobby refuses to give up on his brother.

videos.title: Aakhri Raasta
videos.overview: Determined to uncover the truth behind Bunty's disappearance and clear his family's name, Bobby seeks an audience with the powerful Goldy Sekhon. As questions go unanswered and tensions rise, an unexpected incident changes the dynamic between the two men. Suddenly, Bobby finds himself closer than ever to the people and secrets surrounding his brother's fate.

videos.title: Bobby 2.0
videos.overview: Three months later, Bobby faces new challenges and shifting loyalties as the search for Bunty takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Shikaar
videos.overview: A new lead revives Bobby's search for Bunty as growing tensions within Goldy Sekhon's circle threaten to change everything.

videos.title: Kamna Ki Kaamna
videos.overview: A new clue reignites the search for Bunty as Bobby's growing influence unsettles Kamna, triggering fresh tensions within Goldy's inner circle.

videos.title: Logic And Magic
videos.overview: Gazal uncovers a crucial lead while Bobby follows Bunty's trail, bringing both dangerously close to the truth.

videos.title: Sachchai Ki Keemat
videos.overview: Bobby follows a new trail that links Bunty's disappearance to powerful figures and leads him toward a mysterious border town.

videos.title: Chehre
videos.overview: Bobby uncovers a crucial lead as tensions rise around Kamna, and a reckless move threatens to change the course of the search.

videos.title: Imtihaan
videos.overview: Bobby questions a crucial lead on Bunty as risky moves and shifting alliances raise the stakes for everyone involved.

videos.title: Takkar
videos.overview: As tensions reach breaking point, Bobby finds himself on a collision course with Goldy Sekhon and the world around him.

videos.title: Kambakht Ishq
videos.overview: Bobby follows a crucial lead on Bunty and, with no options left, takes a bold step that changes the game.

videos.title: Aakhri Daanv
videos.overview: Bobby's search for Bunty reaches its climax, bringing long-awaited answers while leaving the future wide open.
